description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. NO. 2059/12 of 20.02.2018, Kesbewa D/S Division and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel titles, including changes to village names, insertion of right-of-way particulars, and expunging of schedule particulars for various land parcels in different locations. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
